main.description: A picture or file a record subject holds, for a moderator reviewing it, even when the group has taken the record down: the record as getModSubjectHistory gives it, in one of the group's spaces the caller's roles let them read, read from whoever wrote it. Requires mod.read.

group.description: The group DID. Every method is served by the group's host and authorized against that group's roles.

subject.description: The record, by its URI in one of the group's spaces.

cid.description: The file, one the record holds as the host's index has it.

errors.name: InvalidSubject
errors.description: The subject isn't an account, a record in this group, or a record in a public repo.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No record the index holds and the caller may read, or a file it does not hold, or one its writer no longer serves.
